cohort: Pregnant women delivering at Cheluvamba Hospital, a tertiary hospital attached to Mysore Medical College & Research Institute, Mysuru, India, between January 1, 2013 and December 31, 2014.
finding: The overall cesarean section rate decreased from 25.8% in 2013 to 29.33% in 2014, with the largest reductions seen in nulliparous women with single cephalic pregnancies at term in spontaneous labor (Group 1) and multiparous women (excluding previous cesarean section) with single cephalic pregnancies at term in spontaneous labor (Group 3).
